definitions.full: H7897. shith שִׁית noun masculine garment (Nö Beiträge, 41 f. , compare Syriac appearance , and question שִׁיֻּת ?); — construct זוֺנָה שִׁית Prov 7:10 ; figurative חָמָס Psa 73:6 (see II. עטף ).
